name: paladin
description: a Paladin, a holy knight: swept blond hair, polished steel plate armour with gold trim, a white tabard with a golden sun emblem, a brown belt, steel greaves and boots, a spiked steel flanged mace on a wooden handle in his RIGHT hand and a white-and-steel kite shield with a golden sun emblem on his LEFT arm
hands: the mace stays in his right hand on the screen-left side and the shield on his left arm on the screen-right side

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, torso leans back toward the upper-left, the mace is lifted beside the head with its spiked head pointing up and back
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and crouched, the mace hand behind the head and the mace hanging back and down behind the shoulders to the left, shield tucked across the belly
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips round, the mace arm sweeps across in front of the chest and the mace is level, its spiked head pointing to the right
strike.4: contact: mace arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the mace's spiked head striking down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, shield arm swung back behind the shoulders for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the mace carries on down until its spiked head nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, torso twisted, hair trailing back
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the mace comes back up on the near side toward the ready angle, shield tucked across the belly

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; head snaps back toward the upper-left, eyes squeezed shut, torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (mace arm thrown up and out to the left, shield flung out to the right)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further toward the upper-left, knees bent, the mace dipping, shield still held out

death.1: stagger back: a step back toward the upper-left, body thrown back, mace arm flung up, shield drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, torso slumps forward, head droops, the mace lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the mace's spiked head resting on the ground at the lower-right, shield arm hanging
death.4: falling back: torso tips back toward the upper-left, the mace slips out of the hand, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on his back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the mace lies on the ground at the lower-right; the shield lies flat beside him
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on his back, eyes closed, mace and shield on the ground beside him
